name: test_external_delivery_gate_accepts_an_exact_case_insensitive_allowlist
description:
Objective: External delivery gate accepts an exact case insensitive allowlist.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/notifications/test_external_delivery_guard.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Invoke `monkeypatch.setenv` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Invoke `monkeypatch.setattr` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
6. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `guard.external_delivery_preflight_problems() == []`.
7. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: External delivery gate accepts an exact case insensitive allowlist.
2. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `guard.external_delivery_preflight_problems() == []`.
3. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
